name: 13-K
description: 13-K was an Infiltrator probe droid produced in a collaboration between Arakyd Industries and Imperial technicians under Admiral Damon Krell following the Battle of Hoth. Augmented with superior armor, weapons and computer interface systems, 13-K became the center of Krell's plot to wipe out the Rebel fleet. 13-K commandeered a Rebel blockade runner and intended to detonate the ship at the Rebel rendezvous point. However, the meddling of Rebel pilot Luke Skywalker, and a failure of 13-K's logic capacitators, led 13-K to instead destroy Krell's Star Destroyer.
